posts.title: [Advisory] Cisco: Critical vulnerabilities affecting Expressway and Snort 3
posts.content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- Successful exploitation could let unauthenticated remote attackers take full root-level control of Expressway devices, or compromise Snort 3-based security appliances, through network access.
- **Current exploitation status**: UNKNOWN

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:
- Cisco Expressway Series
- Cisco Open Source Snort 3 and Snort 3-based Cisco products
- Cisco Unified Communications products
- Cisco IOS XR Software
- Cisco Secure Client 

For specific versions, please check the references.

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:
- **Prerequisites:**
    - **Expressway:** The device is configured in a cluster. The attacker has network access to the database service and possesses the persistent cookies.
    - **Snort 3:** The attacker sends crafted network traffic that Snort 3 inspects. No authentication is required.
- **Impact Details:**
    - **Expressway:** Persistent cookies combine with missing client-certificate validation when TLS Verify Mode is enabled for clustering. This lets attackers invoke database RPC commands that execute as root.
    - **Snort 3:** Grouped memory-corruption and incorrect calculation flaws could compromise the inspection engine.
- **Available Mitigations:**
    - Vendor patches are available for all affected products. There are no workarounds for the Expressway, Snort 3, or Unified Communications issues.
    - Meraki MX, CDFW, and CSA instances were updated automatically by Cisco, so no customer action is required.

##### CVEs IN THIS ADVISORY:
- CVE-2026-76466 CVSS3.1: 9.8 (CRITICAL) - Expressway database service RCE as root via persistent cookies and missing certificate validation
- CVE-2026-76473 CVSS3.1: 9.8 (CRITICAL) - Unified Communications improper resource control (grouped CWE class)
- CVE-2026-76474 CVSS3.1: 9.8 (CRITICAL) - Unified Communications improper authentication, including bypass, session fixation, and replay (grouped)
- CVE-2026-76475 CVSS3.1: 9.3 (CRITICAL) - Unified Communications cross-site scripting / input neutralization flaws (grouped)
- CVE-2026-20043 CVSS3.1: 9.0 (CRITICAL) - Snort 3 out-of-bounds write issues (grouped)
- CVE-2026-20236 CVSS3.1: 9.0 (CRITICAL) - Snort 3 incorrect calculation issues (grouped). The vendor advisory lists 9.0, while the CVE record lists 7.5.


##### REFERENCES:
Primary:
- Source Advisory: https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-notice-QGwHnJ6k (Cisco October 21, 2026 advisory bundle overview)

Supporting:
- News Coverage: https://www.securityweek.com/cisco-patches-34-vulnerabilities-across-multiple-products/ (SecurityWeek coverage of the patch release)

*Timestamp of the Information: 22.10.2026, 14:37*
posts.summary: Cisco has released fixes for 34 vulnerabilities across multiple products including Expressway Series, Snort 3, Unified Communications, IOS XR, and Secure Client. The most serious is a critical flaw in Expressway's database service that could let remote attackers run commands as root on clustered devices. Critical out-of-bounds write and incorrect calculation issues in the Snort 3 inspection engine also affect a wide range of Cisco firewall and security products.

posts.title: [Advisory] PHP2Shell: Critical Security Updates - Patch Now
posts.content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:

- Successful exploitation could allow remote attackers to execute code on affected servers, exposing application data and disrupting services.
- **Current exploitation status:** ~~UNKNOWN~~ **Update 21. October 12:35: Cloudflare claims first exploitation attempts.**
- **Public PoC claims:** Purported exploit code is publicly available, but its functionality and attribution to these vulnerabilities remain unverified.

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:

- PHP, maintained by the PHP Group.

PHP has not yet confirmed the affected versions. PHP 5.4 and later is claimed. For specific versions, please check the references.

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:

Individual technical causes and exploitation prerequisites remain pending official disclosure. No attack chain between the two vulnerabilities has been established publicly.

- **Available Mitigations:**
    - Security updates are scheduled for **21 October 2026 at 14:00 UTC (16:00 CEST, Swiss time)**. PHP may release earlier.
    - Identify PHP-based applications, coordinate update readiness with hosting and software providers, and apply the official fixes promptly upon release.
    - **Temporary:** If prompt patching is not feasible, consider isolating internet-facing PHP applications from public networks.

##### CVEs IN THIS ADVISORY:

- CVE-2026-109618 CVSS4.0: 9.2 (CRITICAL) - Reported remote code execution. Individual technical details pending.
- CVE-2026-109619 CVSS4.0: 9.2 (CRITICAL) - Reported remote code execution. Individual technical details pending.


##### REFERENCES:

Primary:

- Source and Vendor Advisory: [PHP security team's advance release notice](https://www.php.net/archive/2026.php#2026-10-20-1). Confirms severity and release schedule. Technical details and affected/fixed versions are pending.

Supporting:

- Additional Source: [CERT-EU Security Advisory 2026-018](https://cert.europa.eu/publications/security-advisories/2026-018/). Public CVE identifiers, reported impact and interim isolation guidance.
- Additional Source: [watchTowr public FAQ](https://watchtowr.com/intelligence/php-cve-2026-109618-faq/). Exploitation-status reporting. Use PHP's notice for the current release schedule.
- Claimed Proof of Concept: [Third-party repository referencing php-up-2026](https://github.com/Zer061/CVE-2026-109618). Contains purported exploit code and detailed technical claims. Functionality and CVE attribution are unverified.
- Proof of Concept Video: [php2shell exploit demonstration](https://x.com/k_firsov/status/2112641845926989944), attributed to Calif. Demonstrates remote code execution against PHP. Claimed coverage of PHP 5.4 and later.


---
###### Update: 21. October 10:25

Additional public guidance is available covering PHP inventory, patch preparation and temporary measures to reduce exposure:

- Consider disabling session upload progress with `session.upload_progress.enabled = Off`.
- Evaluate blocking multipart requests at the web server or reverse proxy before they reach PHP, where application requirements permit.

**These measures are not confirmed to prevent exploitation of both vulnerabilities and do not replace patching. Blocking multipart requests can disrupt file uploads and forms.** Assess application compatibility and verify that restrictions are effective.

Source: [Vincent Schmalbach: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619: What you should do now](https://www.vincentschmalbach.com/cve-2026-109618-and-cve-2026-109619-what-you-should-do-now/)

---
###### Update: 21. October 12:35

Cloudflare sees first explotation attempts

Source: [Dane Knecht CTO Cloudflare via X](https://x.com/dok2001/status/2112811965735202970)

---

###### Update: 21 October 2026, 15:45

#### PHP has released security updates for both vulnerabilities. Update immediately.

Official technical details and mitigation guidance are now available. The information below supersedes earlier preliminary statements in this post.

###### AFFECTED PRODUCTS AND FIXED VERSIONS:

All unpatched PHP installations serving web requests should be assessed, including PHP-FPM, Apache mod_php, php-cgi, FrankenPHP and LiteSpeed.

| PHP branch | Affected releases | Fixed release |
|---|---|---|
| 8.5 | Before 8.5.12 | **8.5.12** |
| 8.4 | Before 8.4.27 | **8.4.27** |
| 8.3 | Before 8.3.36 | **8.3.36** |
| 8.2 | Before 8.2.35 | **8.2.35** |

Older branches also require remediation. Distribution packages may contain backported fixes without changing the upstream version number. Verify the exact package against your provider's security advisory.

###### CONFIRMED VULNERABILITY DETAILS:

- **CVE-2026-109618, CVSS4.0: 9.2 (CRITICAL):** Out-of-memory handling can leave partially initialised request data in an invalid state. Processing this data during cleanup can lead to unauthenticated RCE.
- **CVE-2026-109619, CVSS4.0: 9.2 (CRITICAL):** Request-owned state can survive after its memory is freed. A subsequent request handled by the same worker can access that stale state, enabling RCE.

Successful exploitation executes code with the **web worker's privileges**.

PHP considers the risk highest for **Apache mod_php**, where exploitation has been demonstrated before application code executes. PHP-FPM is also affected: session-lifecycle RCE has been validated against both mod_php and FPM. Exploitability depends on the specific path, configuration and application.

###### REQUIRED ACTIONS:

- Update all affected PHP deployments, prioritising internet-facing applications and critical systems.
- Restart PHP workers and long-running PHP services after deployment. Verify that running instances use the patched build.
- For managed hosting and vendor appliances, obtain confirmation that the relevant fix has been deployed.
- For PHP 8.1 and older, check distribution or LTS-provider backports or migrate to a supported branch.
- PHP has exceptionally provided **minimal source-backports for PHP 7.4, 8.0 and 8.1**. These do not restore regular upstream support.
- If timely patching is not possible, restrict access or temporarily isolate affected applications.

###### UPDATED TEMPORARY MITIGATION GUIDANCE:

**Only patching provides a complete solution. Configuration changes and WAF rules address individual paths and do not make an unpatched installation safe.**

- **Session paths:** Set `session.upload_progress.enabled=0` in startup configuration, such as `php.ini`, an FPM pool or server configuration, and restart every worker. **Do not rely on `ini_set()` or FPM `.user.ini`.**
- **PHP 8.5 fatal-backtrace path:** Set `fatal_error_backtraces=0` administratively and restart every worker. Other state-corruption paths remain possible.
- **OOM paths:** Assess administratively enforced `memory_limit=-1` alongside suitable container or cgroup memory boundaries. Underlying allocation failures remain possible. Do not substitute `RLIMIT_AS` or `RLIMIT_DATA`.
- Keep `post_max_size` conservative and enforce independent frontend limits on decoded request size, input fields, multipart parts, headers and nesting, including requests without a usable `Content-Length`.
- Block unnecessary multipart requests before they reach PHP. This can disrupt uploads and forms and does not cover every exploitation path.
- Remove invalid or deprecated per-request settings and address attacker-reachable fatal errors and execution timeouts. Suppressing error messages does not resolve these conditions.

###### SOURCES:

- [PHP official security announcement and remediation guidance](https://www.php.net/archive/2026.php)
- [CVE-2026-109618: Official PHP advisory, RCE via OOM corruption](https://github.com/php/php-src/security/advisories/GHSA-w8hw-w9fx-j79w)
- [CVE-2026-109619: Official PHP advisory, RCE via stale global state](https://github.com/php/php-src/security/advisories/GHSA-6wmf-4rv5-p3rp)
- [PHP release changelog](https://www.php.net/ChangeLog-8.php)

The linked security advisories contain detailed technical information.

---
###### Update: 21. October 16:25

Calif has published a detailed technical analysis of PHP2Shell, including exploit demonstrations and additional information on the affected execution paths.

**Source**: [Calif: PHP2Shell technical write-up.](https://calif.io/php2shell/) 

Contains detailed vulnerability analysis and exploit demonstrations.

---
###### Update: 21. October 16:38

**Practical patching guide and additional technical analysis available**

Mattias Geniar has published a practical guide covering PHP updates on Debian, Ubuntu and RHEL-based systems, container deployments, required service restarts and verification that patched PHP is actually running.

Wiz Research has also published a detailed technical write-up. In addition to remote code execution, Wiz demonstrates unauthenticated disclosure of PHP process memory, potentially exposing passwords, authentication tokens and API keys without executing code on the server.

**Source:** 
- [Mattias Geniar: How to apply the patches](https://ma.ttias.be/php-cve-2026-109618-patch/)
- [Wiz Research: PHP2Shell technical analysis and impact](https://www.wiz.io/blog/php2shell-php-rce)
---

###### Update: 21. October 16:50

**PHP2Shell** is now used as the collective name for the vulnerabilities tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. We have updated this post’s title accordingly.

The researchers’ dedicated website brings together vulnerability information, patching guidance and links to technical analyses.

**Source:** [PHP2Shell: Official vulnerability website](https://www.php2shell.com/)

---

###### Update: 21. October 19:35

**Further unverified vulnerability reports**

Additional PHP vulnerability claims are circulating, including reports concerning recently patched versions. These may involve separate issues and do not, by themselves, establish a bypass of the PHP2Shell fixes.

Apply the available patches without delay. Continue monitoring official PHP and vendor advisories, and remain prepared to deploy further security updates or hotfixes. Further research may uncover additional vulnerabilities or exploitation paths.

We will not publish an update for every unverified claim. We will update this post when confirmed, relevant findings change the risk assessment or recommended actions.

---
###### Update: 22. October 02:10

**Threat-hunting and detection resources**

Additional resources are available to support investigation of suspicious activity on PHP-based systems:

- [Zeek and Suricata](https://github.com/corelight/php2shell-detect): Network detection rules published by Corelight.
- [Elastic](https://www.elastic.co/security-labs/threat-command/php2shell-php-rce-detection): Behaviour-based detection guidance and rules for suspicious web-server activity.
- [Microsoft Defender XDR and Sentinel](https://github.com/cseelhoff-ms/php2shell-hunting-pack#table-2-hunt-for-exploitation): Third-party hunting queries covering process activity, crashes, file creation and network connections.

Coverage depends on available telemetry and local configuration. Rules and queries require validation and tuning. Findings do not independently confirm exploitation of these vulnerabilities, and an absence of findings does not exclude compromise.

These resources complement patching and incident investigation.

---

posts.title: [Advisory] GitLab CE/EE: Critical Unauthenticated RCE in Regex Compiler (CVE-2026-110264)
posts.content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- Successful exploitation allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via network access, leading to full compromise.
- **Current exploitation status**: UNKNOWN

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:
- GitLab Community Edition (CE), self-managed
- GitLab Enterprise Edition (EE), self-managed
- GitLab.com and up-to-date GitLab Dedicated tenants are already patched.
- For specific versions, please check the references.

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:
- **Prerequisites:**
    - Network access to a self-managed GitLab instance.
    - No authentication is required.
    - GitLab says exploitation requires "certain conditions" but has not disclosed them.
- **Impact Details:**
    - The flaw sits in Ruby's Onigmo regex engine, which GitLab ships in its own packages.
    - Instances patched during the October 12 update are vulnerable again until upgraded.
- **Available Mitigations:**
    - Vendor patches are available for all supported branches.
    - The fix was also backported to older, normally unsupported branches because of its severity.
    - No official workaround exists, and configuration alone cannot rule out exposure.
    - GitLab published two detection rules for exploitation attempts: 
        - "[Onigmo native worker crash](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-security-oss/tldr/-/blob/main/Detections/platforms/GitLab/Vulnerability%20Detections/onigmo_native_worker_crash.md)" 
        - "[Org mode render error burst](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-security-oss/tldr/-/blob/main/Detections/platforms/GitLab/Vulnerability%20Detections/org_mode_render_error_burst.md)"
    - Some patched versions include database migrations, so plan for downtime on single-node instances.

##### CVEs IN THIS ADVISORY:
- CVE-2026-110264 CVSS3.1: 10.0 (CRITICAL) - Integer overflow in regex compiler leading to unauthenticated RCE

- High severity fixes in the same release:
    - CVE-2026-15723 enables account takeover when SAML and LDAP auto-linking are both enabled.
    - CVE-2026-112212 enables OAuth/OIDC flow redirection through shared-cache poisoning.
    

##### REFERENCES:
Primary:
- Source Advisory: https://docs.gitlab.com/releases/patches/patch-release-gitlab-19-5-1-released/ 

Supporting:
- News Coverage: https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/critical-gitlab-flaw-cvss-100-could.html
- Detection recommendation: https://docs.gitlab.com/security/detecting_security_incidents/ (GitLab TLDR Sigma-based detection framework)
- 
*Timestamp of the Information: 22.10.2026, 07:15*

posts.title: [Advisory] BeyondTrust Remote Support: Arbitrary File Upload Enables Takeover (CVE-2026-102764)
posts.content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- Successful exploitation allows unauthenticated network attackers to compromise appliances, access stored or brokered credentials, and pivot into connected enterprise systems.
- **Current exploitation status:** Actively Exploited

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:
- BeyondTrust Remote Support
- For specific versions, please check the references.

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:
- **Prerequisites:** Network access to an affected Remote Support appliance
- **Impact Details:** Attackers can upload webshells, escalate to root, establish persistent tunnels, harvest credentials, alter administrative permissions, and delete logs.
- **Available Mitigations:**
  - Vendor recommendations: 
  - Self-hosted customers of Remote Support should manually apply the patch if their instance is not subscribed to automatic updates in their /appliance interface. Customers on a Remote Support version older than 24.3.1 will need to upgrade to a newer version to apply this patch. 
  - According to BeyondTrust: As of Oct 9, 2026, a patch that remediates this vulnerability has been applied to all Remote Support SaaS customers. .
  
  - **Temporary:** Isolate suspected appliances, restrict inbound administrative access, limit outbound traffic, terminate active sessions, and rotate credentials after patching or rebuilding.

##### CVEs IN THIS ADVISORY:
- CVE-2026-102764 CVSS4.0: 9.3 (CRITICAL) - Improper message-origin validation enabling arbitrary file operations and appliance takeover

##### REFERENCES:

Primary:
- Source Advisory: https://www.beyondtrust.com/trust-center/security-advisories/bt26-05
- Vendor Guidance: https://www.beyondtrust.com/blog/entry/bt26-05 (Vendor incident response and remediation guidance)
- Technical Analysis: https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/armory-castle-exploits-beyondtrust (Detailed exploitation analysis, indicators, YARA rules, and remediation guidance)


Supporting:
- News Coverage: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/beyondtrust-patches-zero-day-exploited-in-attacks-since-august/

*Timestamp of the Information: 16.10.2026, 09:10*
posts.summary: An origin-validation vulnerability in BeyondTrust Remote Support allows unauthenticated remote attackers to perform arbitrary file operations on affected appliances. The flaw has been exploited as a zero-day to establish persistence, obtain root access, steal credentials, and pivot into internal environments.

posts.title: [Advisory] Drupal Core: Critical Field UI Remote Code Execution (CVE-2026-108097)
posts.content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- A remote unauthenticated attacker can run arbitrary code on Drupal servers, which could lead to full site compromise.
- **Current exploitation status**: UNKNOWN 
- No public exploit code or attacks reported at the time of publication; the vendor warned in a pre-release security announcement that exploits may appear within hours or days

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:
- Drupal core (Field UI module, `field_ui`, installed by the Standard install profile)
- Drupal Entity List contributed module
- End-of-life Drupal branches are affected and will receive no fix
- For specific versions, please check the references.

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:
- **Prerequisites:** Network access to the Drupal site. A contributed module or custom code that exposes the vulnerable render path, with some paths known to  require no authentication.
- **Available Mitigations:**
    - Vendor patches are available for supported Drupal core branches.
    - **Temporary:** Uninstall the Field UI module (`field_ui`) until you can update. Field and display admin pages will be unavailable while it is uninstalled.
    - **Temporary:** Drupal Steward WAF might block some known attack vectors, but not all and would not be a permanent solution.

##### CVEs IN THIS ADVISORY:
- CVE-2026-108097 Drupal Risk Score: 19/25 (CRITICAL) - Field UI arbitrary callable execution leading to RCE

##### REFERENCES:
Primary:
- Source Advisory: https://www.drupal.org/sa-core-2026-014 (Drupal Security Team advisory for CVE-2026-108097)
- Additional Sources: https://www.drupal.org/psa-2026-10-12 (Drupal pre-release security announcement)

Supporting:
- News Coverage: https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/drupal-patches-critical-core-rce-flaw.html

posts.title: [Advisory] Microsoft Patch Tuesday October 2026
posts.content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- **Current exploitation status**: 
    - Actively Exploited (CVE-2026-96951 Windows Shell Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability)
    - Publicly disclosed: CVE-2026-108398 .NET Framework Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability, CVE-2026-92707 MessagePack-CSharp Denial of Service Vulnerability


##### NOTABLE CVEs:

[CVE-2026-96951](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/en-US/vulnerability/CVE-2026-96951) *Windows Shell Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability* (**Actively exploited**)   
An attacker who successfully exploited the vulnerability could evade Mark of the Web (MOTW) defenses, supposed to tags files downloaded from the internet or other untrusted sources with hidden metadata to flag their external origin.
Exploitation requires that a user opens a specially crafted malicious file or visits an attacker-controlled site


*Microsoft Office Outlook Remote Code Execution Vulnerabilities*    
Multiple Microsoft Office Outlook vulnerabilities allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network. 
[CVE-2026-70242](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-70242), [CVE-2026-70291](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-70291), [CVE-2026-88156](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-88156), [CVE-2026-97016](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-97016) and [CVE-2026-97749](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-97749)  trigger when viewing a specifically crafted message in the Outlook Reading Pane. While [CVE-2026-70256](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-70256), [CVE-2026-70257](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-70257), [CVE-2026-70282](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-70282) requires a user to open a specially crafted file from the attacker to initiate remote code execution.

for [CVE-2026-97012](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-97012) an attacker needs to convince a user to connect to a malicious server under their control from an affected client. When the client processes the server's response, the attacker could execute code on the client system. User interaction is required.

[CVE-2026-70571](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-70571) *Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability*    
An unauthenticated attacker could send a specially crafted email to an affected Exchange server, triggering an internal content-conversion process. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to execute code on the server. 
According to Microsoft: Exploitation requires an attacker to have a deep understanding of the target environment and is not guaranteed to succeed as it depends on a combination of factors that might include the environment, system configuration, and the presence of additional security measures. User interaction is not required.

[CVE-2026-102866](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-102866) *Microsoft Office SharePoint Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (EoP)*    
Improper verification of cryptographic signature in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network. 
An unauthenticated attacker who obtains a valid proof token for a targeted user could modify the token and submit it to an affected SharePoint server. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to authenticate as that user and access or modify content available to the compromised account. User interaction is not required.

Multiple other EoP and Remote Code executions have been fixed for SharePoint in this monthly update they are all rated "important" and some require low privileges to exploit .

[CVE-2026-65674](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-65674) *Microsoft SQL Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability*       
Deserialization of untrusted data in SQL Server allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.   
An authenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability by connecting to an affected SQL Server and submitting a specially crafted query or request that triggers a memory corruption condition, allowing the attacker to execute code on the server. Authentication is required; user interaction is not required.

posts.content:

- Ivanti — Connect Secure
- For specific versions, please check the references.

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:

- **Attack Chain:** CVE-2026-104935 is an authentication bypass allowing a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands; attackers chained an unpatched privilege-escalation flaw to obtain root execution.

posts.title: [Advisory] Danfoss AK-SM/AK-SC: Refrigeration Controllers Hijacked in widespread Attacks
posts.content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- Successful compromise lets remote attackers manipulate refrigeration settings through internet-exposed management interfaces, causing damage such as spoiled stock.
- **Current exploitation status**: Actively Exploited

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:
- Danfoss AK-SM 800 System Manager (end-of-life, no longer patched)
- Danfoss AK-SC 355 (phased out, no longer patched)
- Danfoss AK-SM 800A / AK-SM 8xxA Series (current model, when running outdated firmware)
- For specific versions, please check the references and monitor for updates.

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:
- **Prerequisites:** Network access to an internet-exposed controller web management interface. The likeliest targets are end-of-life or unpatched units, often with default credentials or no firewall/VPN.
- **Available Mitigations:**
    - Vendor firmware updates are available for the AK-SM 800A and fix the disclosed CVEs.
    - Newer AK-SM 800A firmware enables Strict Session Control and mandatory HTTPS by default.
    - No fixes exist for the end-of-life AK-SM 800 and AK-SC 355, and Danfoss urges replacing them.
    - **Temporary:** Disconnect controllers from the internet or tightly filter access to trusted IPs or a VPN. Require remote users to log in through a single managed entry point. Change default passwords.
    - **Temporary:** If a controller may be compromised, CERT-FR advises these steps in order:
        1. Limit access to trusted IP and service providers only.
        2. Perform a factory reset.
        3. Apply all available fixes.
        4. Rotate passwords and other secrets.
        5. Review existing accounts.
        6. Fully reconfigure the device.

##### CVEs IN THIS ADVISORY:
Alleged as potentially related:
- CVE-2025-41451 CVSS4.0: 8.7 (HIGH) - Command injection in the alarm-to-mail (SMTP) configuration, enabling post-authentication RCE
- CVE-2025-41450 CVSS3.1: 8.2 (HIGH) - Hidden "code-of-the-day" authentication bypass granting admin access
- CVE-2025-41452 CVSS4.0: 6.8 (MEDIUM) - Post-authentication Nginx configuration injection causing denial of service

##### REFERENCES:
Primary:
- Source Advisory: https://www.cert.ssi.gouv.fr/alerte/CERTFR-2026-ALE-012/ (CERT-FR alert on AK-SM/AK-SC compromises, in French)

posts.summary: Attackers have taken remote control of Danfoss AK-SM and AK-SC controllers at hundreds of supermarkets, mostly in France. Most affected units are alleged to be end-of-life models that no longer receive security updates. Some current-generation controllers running outdated firmware were also allegedly compromised. We have been made aware that this attack is relevant besides Food Supply and could affect other sectors, such as healthcare for specialized cooling equipment, we strongly recommend to review if affected devices are in use at your organization and apply recommended mitigations

posts.title: [Advisory] GitLab CE/EE: Critical RCE in Regex Compiler (CVE-2026-97229)
